column1: # INTERVENTION_CLASSES.tsv — blackbox record type → intervention class (EUC EC-3, D3)
# Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Annex III 1.1.9 asks the machine to keep
# "evidence of a legitimate or illegitimate intervention". The chain already
# keeps every record; this table says, per record type, which kind of
# intervention the record is evidence OF. It is read by the Go writer package
# (go:embed, blackbox.ClassOf) and by the offline verifier's class summary;
# both directions (a type without a row, or a row without a type, is red).
#   legitimate   an authorized intervention took effect (issued, accepted, granted)
#   illegitimate an intervention was refused, or a forgery/violation was detected
#   system       the chain's own bookkeeping — not an intervention by anyone
#   by_payload   the record type carries both outcomes; the payload field named
